title.en: EPA registration for products that claim to kill germs (FIFRA)
title.zh: 宣称杀菌的产品须办理的 EPA 农药登记（FIFRA）

agency.en: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), Office of Pesticide Programs
agency.zh: 美国环境保护署（EPA）农药项目办公室

how.en: A disinfectant, sanitizer or any cleaning product that claims to kill or control germs is a pesticide: the brand registers each product with EPA before it is sold or distributed, with its label, formula and data. Placetta prepares the file; the data studies come from the brand or its lab.
how.zh: 消毒剂、除菌剂或任何宣称能杀灭或控制细菌病毒的清洁产品都属于农药：品牌须在销售或分销前就每个产品向 EPA 登记，提交标签、配方和数据。快哉准备申请材料，数据研究由品牌方或其实验室提供。

feeNote.en: Set by the kind of application under the Pesticide Registration Improvement Act (PRIA).
feeNote.zh: 按《农药登记改进法》（PRIA）规定的申请类型核定。

plain.en: Federal registration for any product sold with a claim that it kills germs, before the first sale.
plain.zh: 凡宣称杀菌的产品，首次销售前须办理的联邦登记。

proof.quote: No person may distribute or sell any pesticide product that is not registered under the Act

form: EPA Form 3540-8 (establishment registration) and EPA Form 3540-16 (production report)

title.en: Pesticide-producing establishment registration and yearly production report
title.zh: 农药生产场所登记及年度生产报告

agency.en: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA)
agency.zh: 美国环境保护署（EPA）

how.en: Each factory that makes, packs or relabels the product, the one abroad included, gets an EPA company number, registers as a pesticide-producing establishment once, then files a production report within 30 days and every year by March 1.
how.zh: 生产、包装或重贴标签的每家工厂（包括境外工厂）须取得 EPA 公司编号，一次性登记为农药生产场所，此后在 30 天内提交首次生产报告，并于每年 3 月 1 日前提交年度报告。

renews.en: Production report every year by March 1.
renews.zh: 每年 3 月 1 日前提交生产报告。

plain.en: The factory that makes a germ-killing product registers with EPA and reports what it produced each year.
plain.zh: 生产杀菌产品的工厂须向 EPA 登记，并每年申报产量。

proof.quote: including companies or establishments that import into the United States, must first obtain a company number; second, register the establishment,

form: EPA Form 3540-1 (Notice of Arrival of Pesticides and Devices)

title.en: Notice of Arrival for each imported shipment of germ-killing products
title.zh: 每批进口杀菌产品的抵港通知（Notice of Arrival）

agency.en: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), with U.S. Customs and Border Protection
agency.zh: 美国环境保护署（EPA）与美国海关与边境保护局（CBP）

how.en: The importer or its customs broker submits the Notice of Arrival before each shipment of disinfectants or sanitizers reaches the US, naming the EPA registration and establishment numbers; EPA says how the shipment may be released.
how.zh: 进口商或其报关行须在每批消毒剂或除菌剂抵达美国前提交抵港通知，写明 EPA 登记号和生产场所编号；EPA 会告知货物如何放行。

plain.en: A notice to EPA before each imported shipment of a germ-killing product arrives.
plain.zh: 每批进口杀菌产品抵达前向 EPA 提交的通知。

proof.quote: must submit to the Administrator, prior to the arrival of the shipment in the United States, a Notice of Arrival of Pesticides and Devices

title.en: TSCA import certification for detergents and cleaning chemicals
title.zh: 洗涤剂及清洁化学品的 TSCA 进口认证

agency.en: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), at entry through U.S. Customs and Border Protection
agency.zh: 美国环境保护署（EPA），入境时经美国海关与边境保护局（CBP）申报

how.en: At entry, the importer or its broker certifies that every chemical substance in the shipment, as a chemical or as part of a mixture such as a detergent, complies with TSCA. Products registered as pesticides are covered by FIFRA instead. Separate from the composite wood certification for furniture.
how.zh: 入境时，进口商或其报关行须证明货物中的每种化学物质（无论是单独的化学品还是洗涤剂等混合物的成分）均符合 TSCA。已登记为农药的产品改由 FIFRA 管辖。此项与家具的复合木材认证分开。

feeNote.en: The rule names no fee; the broker usually makes it with the entry.
feeNote.zh: 该规定未列出费用；通常由报关行随报关一并申报。

plain.en: A statement with each import of detergents or cleaning chemicals that they meet the federal chemicals law.
plain.zh: 每次进口洗涤剂或清洁化学品时声明其符合联邦化学品法规。

proof.quote: must certify in writing or electronically that the chemical shipment complies with all applicable rules and orders under TSCA

form: 16 CFR parts 1632 and 1633 (mattress flammability), records and certification

title.en: Mattress flammability standards: prototype tests, records kept in the US, and the certification label
title.zh: 床垫阻燃标准：原型测试、在美国保存记录及合格标签

agency.en: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC)
agency.zh: 美国消费品安全委员会（CPSC）

how.en: Every mattress model is made from a prototype that passed the open-flame test (part 1633) and the cigarette test (part 1632). The importer or maker keeps the test and manufacturing records in English at a US location, labels each mattress with its certification, and issues the certificate CPSC requires at entry. There is no government form.
how.zh: 每款床垫须基于通过明火测试（第 1633 部分）和香烟阴燃测试（第 1632 部分）的原型生产。进口商或制造商须在美国境内以英文保存测试和生产记录，在每张床垫上标注合格声明，并出具 CPSC 要求在入境时提供的证书。没有政府表格。

feeNote.en: No government filing: the records stay with the importer or maker.
feeNote.zh: 无需向政府申报：记录由进口商或制造商保存。

plain.en: The federal fire rules for mattresses: tested prototypes, records kept in the US, and a certification on every mattress.
plain.zh: 联邦床垫防火规定：原型须经测试、记录保存在美国，每张床垫都须标注合格声明。

proof.quote: irrespective of whether guarantees are issued relative thereto, shall maintain the following records in English at a location in the United States

form: Form FDA 2541 (food canning establishment registration) and process filings

title.en: Canned and acidified food: canning establishment registration (FCE) and process filing (SID)
title.zh: 罐头及酸化食品：罐装企业注册（FCE）及工艺备案（SID）

agency.en: U.S. Food and Drug Administration
agency.zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）

how.en: The plant that makes shelf-stable canned, jarred or acidified food, the one abroad included, registers with FDA on Form 2541 and files the scheduled process for each product and container size before any of it is offered for import. Filed online in FDA Industry Systems.
how.zh: 生产常温保存的罐头、瓶装或酸化食品的工厂（包括境外工厂）须以 FDA 2541 表向 FDA 注册，并在任何产品进口前就每种产品及容器规格备案工艺规程。在 FDA 行业系统在线提交。

plain.en: FDA registration of the canning plant and its process for each canned or pickled food, before the first shipment.
plain.zh: 首批货物前，罐装工厂及每种罐头或腌制食品的工艺须在 FDA 注册备案。

proof.quote: Foreign processors shall register before any offering of foods for import into the United States.

title.en: USDA FSIS import inspection application for each meat or poultry shipment
title.zh: 每批肉类或禽类产品的 USDA FSIS 进口检验申请

agency.en: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS)
agency.zh: 美国农业部食品安全检验局（FSIS）

how.en: Meat, poultry and foods made with them come only from countries and plants FSIS lists as eligible, with the foreign government's health certificate. For each consignment the importer or broker submits the import inspection application before the shipment reaches the official import establishment, where FSIS reinspects it.
how.zh: 肉类、禽类及含其成分的食品只能来自 FSIS 认定合格的国家和工厂，并附出口国政府的卫生证书。每批货物到达官方进口检验场所前，进口商或报关行须提交进口检验申请，由 FSIS 复检。

plain.en: A USDA inspection request for every shipment of imported meat or poultry, sent before it arrives.
plain.zh: 每批进口肉类或禽类产品抵达前提交的 USDA 检验申请。

proof.quote: Import inspection applications for each consignment must be submitted (electronically or on paper) to FSIS in advance of the shipment's arrival

form: License to manufacture and sell bedding and upholstered furniture (Division of Food Protection)

title.en: Massachusetts license for bedding and upholstered furniture makers
title.zh: 马萨诸塞州床上用品及软体家具制造商执照

agency.en: Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Division of Food Protection
agency.zh: 马萨诸塞州公共卫生部食品保护处

how.en: Applied for on the Environmental Health eLicensing Portal, one application and fee for each manufacturing facility, the factory abroad included, before its mattresses, bedding or upholstered furniture are sold in Massachusetts. Allow 6 to 8 weeks.
how.zh: 在马萨诸塞州销售床垫、床上用品或软体家具前，须在环境卫生电子执照门户申请，每个生产工厂（包括境外工厂）各提交一份申请并缴费。处理约需 6 至 8 周。

feeNote.zh: 每个生产工厂 300 美元。

plain.en: Massachusetts licenses each factory whose bedding or upholstered furniture is sold in the state.
plain.zh: 马萨诸塞州为其床上用品或软体家具在该州销售的每家工厂发放执照。

proof.quote: You must have a license from the Division of Food Protection (DFP) to manufacture and sell stuffed toys, bedding, upholstered furniture,

title.en: Pennsylvania bedding and upholstery registration
title.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州床上用品及软体家具登记

agency.en: Pennsylvania Department of Labor and Industry, Bureau of Occupational and Industrial Safety
agency.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州劳工与工业部职业与工业安全局

how.en: The manufacturer registers with the Bureau, on Form LIBU-32 or the eDAP portal with the fee, before its bedding or upholstered furniture is sold in Pennsylvania. An importer may register together with a manufacturer, once for each factory it imports from.
how.zh: 制造商须在其床上用品或软体家具于宾夕法尼亚州销售前，通过 LIBU-32 表或 eDAP 门户向该局登记并缴费。进口商可与制造商一同登记，所进口的每家工厂各登记一次。

plain.en: Pennsylvania's registration for bedding and upholstered furniture makers whose goods are sold in the state.
plain.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州对其产品在该州销售的床上用品及软体家具制造商的登记。

proof.quote: The law requires manufacturers to use only new filling materials in bedding and upholstered furniture and register with the Bureau

form: Bedding Manufacturers & Refurbisher license (General Business Law article 25-A)

title.en: New York license for makers of new mattresses and box springs
title.zh: 纽约州新床垫及弹簧床座制造商执照

agency.en: New York Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
agency.zh: 纽约州务院执照服务处

how.en: The manufacturer of new mattresses or box springs sold in New York files the application with the fee, stating its name and address and affirming that it uses only new material. Paid by check, money order or a credit card authorization form; renewed every year.
how.zh: 在纽约州销售的新床垫或弹簧床座的制造商须提交申请并缴费，写明名称和地址，并声明只使用新材料。以支票、汇票或信用卡授权表付款；每年续期。

plain.en: New York's yearly license for anyone making new mattresses sold in the state.
plain.zh: 在纽约州销售新床垫的制造商须办理的年度执照。

proof.quote: Every manufacturer of new bedding sold in this state shall file a notice with the Department of State

title.en: Connecticut importer's license for bedding and upholstered furniture
title.zh: 康涅狄格州床上用品及软体家具进口商执照

agency.en: Connecticut Department of Consumer Protection, License Services Division
agency.zh: 康涅狄格州消费者保护部执照服务处

how.en: A business that imports bedding or upholstered furniture from outside the US holds one importer license, applied for online or by mail. Each factory it imports from also holds its own Connecticut manufacturer license ($100), which the importer may pay for. Every license expires April 30.
how.zh: 从美国境外进口床上用品或软体家具的企业须持有一张进口商执照，可在线或邮寄申请。其进口的每家工厂还须各自持有康涅狄格州制造商执照（100 美元），可由进口商代缴。所有执照均于 4 月 30 日到期。

plain.en: Connecticut's yearly license for importers of bedding and upholstered furniture, plus one for each factory.
plain.zh: 康涅狄格州对床上用品及软体家具进口商的年度执照，每家工厂另需一张。

proof.quote: The fee for the importer license is $100 annually and will always expire on April 30th.

form: Bedding, Upholstered Furniture, and Quilted Clothing permit

title.en: Utah permit for bedding and upholstered furniture makers and importers
title.zh: 犹他州床上用品及软体家具制造商和进口商许可

agency.en: Utah Department of Agriculture and Food, Regulatory Services
agency.zh: 犹他州农业与食品部监管服务处

how.en: Every manufacturer, supply dealer and wholesaler, importers included, whose bedding or upholstered furniture is offered for sale in Utah applies online for its permit before the goods enter the state. The permit year runs January 1 to December 31.
how.zh: 凡在犹他州销售床上用品或软体家具的制造商、供应商和批发商（包括进口商），须在货物进入该州前在线申请许可。许可年度为 1 月 1 日至 12 月 31 日。

renews.zh: 每年一次，1 月 1 日至 12 月 31 日。

plain.en: Utah's yearly permit, needed before bedding or upholstered furniture enters the state.
plain.zh: 犹他州的年度许可，床上用品或软体家具进入该州前须取得。

proof.quote: This permit must be purchased prior to the time such merchandise enters the State of Utah

form: Bedding and Upholstery registration (West Virginia Code 47-1A)

title.en: West Virginia bedding and upholstery registration
title.zh: 西弗吉尼亚州床上用品及软体家具登记

agency.en: West Virginia Division of Labor, Bedding and Upholstery
agency.zh: 西弗吉尼亚州劳工处床上用品与软体家具科

how.en: Manufacturers of bedding and upholstered furniture sold in West Virginia register with the Division using its application packet.
how.zh: 在西弗吉尼亚州销售的床上用品及软体家具的制造商须使用该处的申请材料包向其登记。

plain.en: West Virginia's registration for makers of bedding and upholstered furniture sold in the state.
plain.zh: 西弗吉尼亚州对其产品在该州销售的床上用品及软体家具制造商的登记。

proof.quote: the section registers all manufacturers, renovators and sterilizers of bedding materials

title.en: Virginia license for bedding and upholstered furniture makers and importers
title.zh: 弗吉尼亚州床上用品及软体家具制造商和进口商执照

agency.en: Virginia Department of Health, Bedding and Upholstered Furniture Program
agency.zh: 弗吉尼亚州卫生部床上用品与软体家具项目

how.en: Manufacturers, importers and distributors are licensed before offering bedding or upholstered furniture for sale in Virginia, one license for each place of business, renewed every year. Every piece carries a law label with the Uniform Registry Number.
how.zh: 制造商、进口商和分销商在弗吉尼亚州销售床上用品或软体家具前须取得执照，每个营业地点一张，每年续期。每件产品须贴有带统一登记号的法定标签。

plain.en: Virginia's yearly license for anyone making or importing bedding or upholstered furniture sold there.
plain.zh: 在弗吉尼亚州销售的床上用品或软体家具，其制造商或进口商须办理的年度执照。

proof.quote: All manufacturers, importers, distributors, reupholsterers, and renovators must be licensed to offer bedding and upholstered furniture for sale in Virginia.

title.en: DC registration for businesses that make or sell mattresses, bedding or upholstered furniture
title.zh: 华盛顿特区床垫、床上用品或软体家具制造及销售企业登记

agency.en: DC Health, Division of Community Hygiene
agency.zh: 华盛顿特区卫生局社区卫生处

how.en: Registered online with the Division, uploading the Basic Business License and, where there is one, the Certificate of Occupancy. Stores and warehouses that keep mattresses or bedding for sale register too.
how.zh: 在线向该处登记，并上传基本营业执照及（如有）占用证书。存放待售床垫或床上用品的门店和仓库也须登记。

feeNote.en: $476 every two years for a maker; $34 every two years for a store or warehouse.
feeNote.zh: 制造商每两年 476 美元；门店或仓库每两年 34 美元。

plain.en: DC's registration for anyone making, storing or selling mattresses, bedding or upholstered furniture there.
plain.zh: 在华盛顿特区制造、存放或销售床垫、床上用品或软体家具的企业须办理的登记。

proof.quote: who manufacture, renovate, or deal in bedding, mattress, or other upholstered furniture must register with DC Health's Division of Community Hygiene

title.en: North Carolina bedding manufacturer license
title.zh: 北卡罗来纳州床上用品制造商执照

agency.en: North Carolina Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services, Sleep Products Section
agency.zh: 北卡罗来纳州农业与消费者服务部睡眠产品科

how.en: The manufacturer files the new bedding manufacturer application with the registration number request and a sample law label before its mattresses or bedding are sold in North Carolina, and renews every year.
how.zh: 制造商须在其床垫或床上用品于北卡罗来纳州销售前提交新床上用品制造商申请、登记号申请表及法定标签样本，并每年续期。

feeNote.en: $720 for the first year, prorated by the quarter business starts; after that 5.2 cents a unit sold in the state, $50 at least.
feeNote.zh: 第一年 720 美元，按开始营业的季度折算；此后按在该州销售的每件 5.2 美分计，最低 50 美元。

plain.en: North Carolina's yearly license for makers of mattresses and bedding sold in the state.
plain.zh: 在北卡罗来纳州销售的床垫及床上用品的制造商须办理的年度执照。

proof.quote: A person who has not done business in this State throughout the preceding calendar year shall obtain a license by paying an initial fee

form: Bedding manufacturer permit (16 Del. C. chapter 21)

title.en: Delaware bedding manufacturer permit
title.zh: 特拉华州床上用品制造商许可

agency.en: Delaware Division of Public Health, Bedding Program
agency.zh: 特拉华州公共卫生处床上用品项目

how.en: Manufacturers of mattresses, pillows and other bedding made in Delaware or shipped into it register with the Division for a permit and a registry number, renewed each calendar year.
how.zh: 在特拉华州生产或运入该州的床垫、枕头及其他床上用品的制造商须向该处登记，取得许可和登记号，每个日历年续期。

plain.en: Delaware's yearly permit for makers of bedding sold or shipped into the state.
plain.zh: 在特拉华州销售或运入该州的床上用品的制造商须办理的年度许可。

proof.quote: for manufacturers of bedding products within the State or manufacturers of such products who ship said products into this State shall be as follows

form: Producer responsibility organization registration (Recycling Reform Act, RCW 70A.208)

title.en: Washington packaging producer responsibility (EPR): register with the PRO, unless exempt
title.zh: 华盛顿州包装生产者责任（EPR）：在生产者责任组织登记（豁免者除外）

agency.en: Washington Department of Ecology, through the approved producer responsibility organization
agency.zh: 华盛顿州生态部（经批准的生产者责任组织）

how.en: Starting in 2026, the brand whose packaged products reach Washington consumers registers with the approved producer responsibility organization, reports its packaging and pays the organization's fees. De minimis producers are exempt.
how.zh: 自 2026 年起，其包装产品销往华盛顿州消费者的品牌须在经批准的生产者责任组织登记、申报包装并缴纳该组织的费用。低于最低限额的生产者豁免。

feeNote.en: The producer responsibility organization sets the fees.
feeNote.zh: 费用由生产者责任组织核定。

plain.en: Washington's packaging law: the brand joins the producer organization and pays into recycling, unless exempt.
plain.zh: 华盛顿州包装法：品牌须加入生产者组织并为回收付费（豁免者除外）。

proof.quote: must meet the following obligations (per RCW 70A.208.030): Register with an approved producer responsibility organization (PRO)

form: Producer responsibility organization membership (Packaging Waste and Cost Reduction Act, Minn. Stat. 115A.144 to 115A.1463)

title.en: Minnesota packaging producer responsibility (EPR): join the PRO, unless exempt
title.zh: 明尼苏达州包装生产者责任（EPR）：加入生产者责任组织（豁免者除外）

agency.en: Minnesota Pollution Control Agency, through Circular Action Alliance
agency.zh: 明尼苏达州污染控制局（经 Circular Action Alliance）

how.en: The brand whose packaged products are sold in Minnesota belongs to the producer responsibility organization, reports its packaging and pays its dues every year.
how.zh: 在明尼苏达州销售包装产品的品牌须加入生产者责任组织、申报包装并每年缴纳会费。

feeNote.en: The producer responsibility organization sets the dues.
feeNote.zh: 会费由生产者责任组织核定。

plain.en: Minnesota's packaging law: the brand joins the producer organization and pays into recycling every year.
plain.zh: 明尼苏达州包装法：品牌须加入生产者组织并每年为回收付费。

proof.quote: By January 1, 2025, producers must appoint a producer responsibility organization.

title.en: Alabama registration for disinfecting and germ-killing products (state pesticide registration)
title.zh: 阿拉巴马州消毒杀菌类产品登记（州农药登记）
